feature_name: Provisioning wizard auto-allocation of /22 and /28 IP ranges
summary: The Apigee provisioning wizard can automatically allocate /22 and /28 IP address ranges instead of requiring a larger /21 range.
extended_definition: The Apigee provisioning wizard can automatically allocate /22 and /28 IP address ranges instead of requiring a larger /21 range.
